The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains unclear. The integration of these findings supports the hypothesis that Cholesteryl chloride could be a modulator of CCF-STTG1, though further experimental validation is required to confirm the direct interaction and the specific molecular mechanism involved.
